text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher amid commitments by both small and institutional investors ending a lingering bear-run, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) index rose 4.91 points or 0.52 percent at 944.57 on a turnover of 46.2 million taka. Gainers led losers by 75 to 50.

"Shares prices were attractive after a long spell of bear run. They (investors) just took advantage of cheaper stocks," said broker Shakil Rizvi. There were not many sellers in the market after investors had completed betting on IPOs (initial public offerings), he said.
